blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) on Tuesday, Nov. 3, launched a nationwide 24/7 hotline where workers, employers and other stakeholders can report workplace concerns and labor-related violations. Dubbed “15/30,” the hotline was introduced during the department’s flag-raising ceremony as part of its preparations for the expected El Niño, which could expose outdoor workers to extreme heat and drought. Complaints received through the hotline will be forwarded to the agency’s regional and field offices for appropriate action.
